subject: Helixion demo — morning block options, sponsor coverage & recording preference
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helixion demo — morning block options, sponsor coverage & recording preference

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. We're excited to run a focused product demo for Helixion next week. To make sure we lock the right executive slot (VP / CIO), can you confirm which of these morning windows works best for your leadership?

Options (Pacific time):
- Tuesday 16 May — 9:00–9:45 AM PT (preferred by our demo lead)
- Wednesday 17 May — 10:00–10:45 AM PT (slightly later; gives your team extra prep time)

Two quick asks:
1) Will your CIO or VP plan to join live? If so, please confirm who and whether they prefer the earlier or later slot.
2) Do you want the session recorded? We can record but will only do so with explicit approval from Helixion execs.

I've attached a short agenda and a one-pager tailored for a VP-level audience. Ben and Karthik are cc'd — Ben will run the demo, Karthik will handle the architecture Q&A. If the named exec can't make it, Ben can provide an exec-level summary immediately after and Karthik can stay on for tech details.

Attachment: agenda_v0.pdf (application/pdf, 85 KB)
Attachment: vp_brief_onepager.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 42 KB)

Next steps: if you confirm a slot and exec attendee, I'll send an updated calendar invite with a short run-of-show and a DocuSign link for the standard NDA/recording consent (if needed).

Cheers,
Grace

Subject: Re: Helixion demo — morning block options, sponsor coverage & recording preference

Grace —

Thanks for the options. Both slots look doable, but our CIO (Maya Patel) prefers earlier in the day and asked whether we can move it up by 15 minutes to better fit travel. Would 8:45–9:30 AM PT on Tuesday 16 May work for your team? If not, we can take the 10:00 slot on Wednesday.

Maya will join if the time is confirmed; she's asked for a 10-minute overview focused on cost/latency tradeoffs and a short Q&A. Re: recording, Maya is ok with a recording as long as it's only for internal Helixion review — no public distribution.

If you need to loop in broader stakeholders on your side, please do.

Best,
Jordan
